caveats: Deputy/Detective Carryn Barker (former SWAT operator) sued San Mateo County over sexual harassment and a 2021 sexual assault by SWAT team leader Sgt. Andre Moniot; filed Nov 9, 2022 in San Mateo County Superior Court; $8M settlement reached July 2024 before a September trial, described as one of California's largest single-plaintiff harassment settlements; county admitted no fault. No source mentions criminal charges against Moniot (only an August 2022 internal affairs investigation; he no longer works for the office), so criminal_status is unknown rather than none_filed.
